description: The UK Civil Aviation Authority collects statistics from more than 60 UK airports: each airport supplies a record of every air transport flight, while other movements such as private or aero club flights are reported as monthly totals. From these records the CAA publishes monthly and annual tables of activity at each reporting airport, including the size of UK airports, aircraft movements, transport movements by type, passengers and freight, and traffic and capacity on routes to and from each airport. National coverage runs as monthly publications from 2015 to 2026 and as scanned paper publications back to 1983 (airport and airline tables from 1973). The tables are free to download as CSV and PDF from the CAA website, and bespoke reports can be commissioned. Terms on the page: the CAA gives no warranty as to accuracy, the statistics may not be sold on to a third party, and publications must reference CAA statistics. Caveats: some table series (2, 7 and 11) are discontinued, and older years exist only as scans. The series support capacity planning and demand calibration for UK airport and air network models, and exposure studies weighted by traffic. They complement the Netherlands CBS airport statistics and the global ACI data.
